enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Curls up. Moves arm under pillow. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Transfer eggs to plate. Open drawer. Take fork. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag, and preparing for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Close closet. Open drawer. Take out socks and underwear. Close drawer. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Open shoe rack. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Insert laptop. Insert stethoscope. Insert notebook. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to clinic. Enter clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional at the clinic or hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Enter clinic. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Call first patient. Escort to exam room. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer vaccine. Write prescription. Update electronic health record. Call next patient. Repeat. Clock out.
Walk out of clinic. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Insert card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Put down bag. Take off shoes.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Load glasses. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Wipe stove. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing light household cleaning and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up items from floor. Place on shelf. Pick up pillows. Fluff pillows. Place on couch. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum floor. Turn off. Unplug. Put away vacuum. Wipe coffee table. Turn off light. Walk out of living room.

Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Put down snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and personal hygiene before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on phone and winding down for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open reading app. Scroll. Read. Turn page. Read. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Close eyes.

Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Curls up. Moves arm under pillow. Remains asleep.
